Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Attaching the SOW and a short checklist to get the Dedicated capacity onboarding scheduled. High-level asks we need answered to start provisioning:

- Preferred primary region (you mentioned US-East during the call; confirm)

Best,

Looping in the infra plan — high-level provisioning notes (summary):

- Staging pool: 4 x A100-80GB (shared staging, warmed images) — should be ready in ~48–72 hrs after we get region confirmation and network access.
- Production pool initial: 12 x A100-80GB, configured into 3 worker groups (4/4/4) to support graceful draining during upgrades.
- Autoscale policy: baseline target utilization at 60%; scale-up threshold at 75% sustained for 60s, scale-up step +2 GPUs; scale-down threshold at 40% sustained for 120s, scale-down step -1 GPU. Burst cap enforced at 2.5x baseline by default (can be adjusted per mutual action plan).
- Cold-start mitigation: keep a small warm cache of commonly used model shards and implement a short pre-warm hook on suspected marketing pushes (we can accept a webhook from StellarPay to pre-warm a configured prefix).
- Network/region notes: US-East (primary), recommend US-West as secondary for failover if you expect cross-coast traffic later; multi-region adds ~18% cost but improves p99 by ~60–120ms for west-coast users.

Attachments: redwood_provisioning_runbook.md, gpu-pool-config.yaml (includes exact kernel/quant flags we'll use for the model family you selected).

I'll join the kickoff; Monica, please share available windows.

-Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
